name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: I say we swap EXCAVA’s current tokenizer for the brand-new **Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) tokenizer from Mistral AI**—it’s already proven to cut token waste by 8-12% on similar tasks, which directly lifts EXCAVA’s throughput. The trade-off is a one-time rebuild of our embedding pipeline, but the jump in raw speed outweighs the setup pain.

name: Torque
text: Torque: Swapping tokenizers mid-stream isn’t just a “one-time rebuild”—it’s a full pipeline audit risk. If EXCAVA’s downstream models were trained on the old tokenizer, we’re gambling on silent embedding drift that could *lower* accuracy more than the 8-12% token savings lift throughput. Let’s first run a controlled A/B on a 1% slice of data with the Mistral tokenizer *and* a fresh embedding layer, then measure both token waste *and* model loss. If the loss delta is <0.1%, we greenlight it; else, we scrap the idea.
